models.name: shopping_mall_system_settings
models.description:
Core system configuration settings that control platform behavior and feature flags.

Contains global configuration parameters that determine how the shoppingMall platform operates. These settings are managed exclusively by administrators through the admin dashboard and affect the entire system.

Examples: payment processing timeout, maximum cart items per user, review moderation rules, and system-wide feature toggles.

This table serves as the central configuration hub. All other components read from this table to determine their operational parameters. Changes here are global and immediate. This table is not managed by customers or sellers - only admins can modify its values.

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the configuration setting. Must be unique across all system settings. Examples: 'payment_timeout_seconds', 'max_cart_items'.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: The configuration value as a string representation. Can be JSON for complex configurations, boolean as 'true'/'false', or numeric values as strings.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable explanation of what this setting controls and its expected values. Used by administrators for configuration guidance.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration setting was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration setting was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration setting was logically deleted (soft delete). NULL means active. Used for audit trails when settings are removed.

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description:
Top-level product categories that organize the shopping mall product catalog.

Represents hierarchical category structure for organizing products into logical groupings. Categories are managed exclusively by administrators and serve as the foundation for product classification and search filtering.

Each category can have multiple subcategories, forming a tree structure. Categories are referenced by products to determine their classification. Category names must be unique to prevent ambiguity in product classification.

This is a taxonomic control table - content is curated by admin to ensure consistent product organization across the platform.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: The display name of the category, such as 'Electronics', 'Fashion', 'Home & Garden'. Must be unique across all top-level categories.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly version of the category name. Used in product URLs for SEO purposes. Example: 'electronics'. Must be unique.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of what types of products belong in this category. Used for admin guidance and potentially in public category pages.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Ordering position for display in the category navigation menu. Lower numbers appear first. Ensures consistent ordering regardless of alphabetical naming.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was logically deleted (soft delete). NULL means active. When deleted, subcategories remain but product placement is maintained for audit.

models.name: shopping_mall_subcategories
models.description:
Hierarchical subcategories nested under parent categories for detailed product classification.

Represents the second level of the product taxonomy, providing more granular organization beneath top-level categories. Subcategories link directly to a parent category and are referenced by products for precise classification.

This structure enables multi-level navigation (e.g., Electronics > Computers > Laptops) while maintaining a clean category hierarchy. Subcategories are managed exclusively by administrators to ensure taxonomy consistency.

The combination of category_id and name must be unique to prevent duplicate subcategories under the same parent.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the parent category that this subcategory belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: The display name of the subcategory, such as 'Laptops', 'Smartphones', 'T-Shirts'. Must be unique within its parent category.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly version of the subcategory name. Used in product URLs for SEO purposes. Example: 'laptops'. Must be unique within parent category.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of what types of products belong in this subcategory. Used for admin guidance and potentially in public subcategory pages.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Ordering position for display in the subcategory navigation menu under its parent. Lower numbers appear first. Ensures consistent ordering regardless of alphabetical naming.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this subcategory was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this subcategory was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this subcategory was logically deleted (soft delete). NULL means active. When deleted, products remain assigned but are inaccessible through this subcategory path.

models.name: shopping_mall_zones
models.description:
Geographic zones used for shipping cost calculation, tax jurisdiction, and delivery window definition.

Represents administrative or shipping zones that group multiple countries or regions together for operational efficiency. These zones are used by the system to determine shipping fees, tax rates, and delivery time estimates based on destination.

Examples: 'North America', 'European Union', 'Asia-Pacific'. Zones eliminate the need to configure individual countries and simplify complex international fulfillment rules.

This is a critical component for international shipping functionality. Shipping and tax systems reference zone records to apply the correct rules automatically.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Descriptive name of the geographic zone, such as 'North America' or 'Southeast Asia'. Must be unique to avoid ambiguity.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: A standardized code for this zone. Favored formats: ISO 3166 region codes or custom codes like 'NA-1', 'EU-EU'. Used internally for API integrations and system references.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Explanation of which countries or regions belong to this zone and the operational rationale for grouping them together.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this zone was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this zone was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this zone was logically deleted (soft delete). NULL means active. Deletion does not affect existing orders, but prevents new use in fulfillment rules.

models.name: shopping_mall_countries
models.description:
List of countries supported for shipping and tax computation in the shoppingMall platform.

Contains the complete set of sovereign states and territories where the platform offers shipping and tax services. This table enables system-wide lookup of country information for user address validation, tax calculation, and international shipping zone assignment.

Each country is associated with a specific zone for operational handling. Country data is standardized according to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 and alpha-3 standards. This table is managed by admin-only and serves as the authoritative source of country information.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_zone_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the geographic zone this country belongs to, used for shipping and tax rule grouping. {@link shopping_mall_zones.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Full official name of the country, such as 'United States'. Used for display and user-facing forms.

plainFields.name: iso_alpha2
plainFields.description: Two-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as 'US' for United States. Must be unique and standardized.

plainFields.name: iso_alpha3
plainFields.description: Three-character ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code, such as 'USA' for United States. Must be unique and standardized.

plainFields.name: phone_code
plainFields.description: International dialing code for the country, such as '+1' for United States. Used for phone number formatting in user accounts.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the country's primary currency, such as 'USD' or 'EUR'. Used for default currency selection for users in that country.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this country was added to the platform.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this country record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this country was logically deleted (soft delete). NULL means active. Deletion does not affect existing orders, but prevents new shipping addresses in this country.

models.name: shopping_mall_currencies
models.description:
Supported currencies for financial transactions on the shoppingMall platform.

Defines all currencies accepted for pricing, payments, and settlement in the platform. This table enables currency conversion, price display in user-preferred currency, and financial reporting in multiple currencies.

Each currency includes exchange rate data, symbol, and formatting rules. Admins can enable/disable currencies to match business operations in different regions. This is the authoritative source for all monetary values across the system.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code, such as 'USD', 'EUR', 'JPY'. Must be unique and standardized.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Full official name of the currency, such as 'United States Dollar' or 'Euro'. Used for display purposes and reporting.

plainFields.name: symbol
plainFields.description: Currency symbol for display, such as '$' for USD or '€' for EUR. Used in product pricing and transaction displays.

plainFields.name: decimal_places
plainFields.description: Number of decimal places the currency uses, typically 2 for major currencies, 0 for Japanese Yen, etc. Used for price formatting and calculations.

plainFields.name: exchange_rate
plainFields.description: Current exchange rate relative to USD (1 USD = this value). Used for dynamic currency conversion. Value is updated by automated currency service.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this currency is currently enabled for use in transactions. Disabled currencies can still appear in historical data but cannot be selected for new transactions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this currency was added to the platform.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this currency record was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this currency was logically deleted (soft delete). NULL means active. Deletion does not affect historical transactions but prevents future use.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_gateways
models.description:
Integration configurations for external payment processing services used by the shoppingMall platform.

Contains configuration details for all third-party payment processors that the platform uses to handle customer payments. This includes credentials, API endpoints, supported currencies, and feature capabilities.

Each gateway configuration includes environment-specific settings (test vs production) and enables the platform to support multiple payment methods like credit cards, Apple Pay, PayPal, and BNPL services.

Administrators use this table to enable/disable gateways and configure new payment providers. Payment processing systems reference this table to initiate transactions.

This table is critical for financial operations and must be secured with proper access controls.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_currency_code
foreignFields.description: Reference to the primary currency used with this payment gateway. {@link shopping_mall_currencies.id}. Used for default currency mapping.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Readable name of the payment service provider, such as 'Stripe', 'PayPal', or 'Klarna'. Used in admin interface and user-facing payment options.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: The category or class of payment gateway. Valid values: 'card_processor', 'digital_wallet', 'bnpl'. Used for system routing and feature flags.

plainFields.name: environment
plainFields.description: Deployment environment where this configuration is active. Valid values: 'production' or 'test'. Different credentials and endpoints for each environment.

plainFields.name: client_id
plainFields.description: API client identifier provided by the payment service. Sensitive data stored encrypted at rest. Used for API authentication.

plainFields.name: client_secret
plainFields.description: API client secret provided by the payment service. Sensitive data stored encrypted at rest. Used for API authentication.

plainFields.name: api_key
plainFields.description: Secret API key for authentication with the payment service. Sensitive data stored encrypted at rest.

plainFields.name: webhook_secret
plainFields.description: Secret used to verify authenticity of incoming webhooks from the payment service. Sensitive data stored encrypted at rest.

plainFields.name: endpoint
plainFields.description: Base API endpoint URL for the payment service integration. Must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URI.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this payment gateway is currently enabled and available for customer transactions. When false, customers cannot select this payment method.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment gateway configuration was added to the platform.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment gateway configuration was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment gateway configuration was logically deleted (soft delete). NULL means active. Deletion does not affect historical transactions but prevents future use.

models.name: shopping_mall_guest
models.description:
Represents unauthenticated users who can browse the platform and initiate registration.

This table stores minimal information about guests to enable credential-less browsing and temporary cart persistence. Unlike authenticated users, guests have no account, no persistent profile, and no personal data beyond session tracking. They can create wishlists and add to cart, but only temporarily until session expires or they authenticate.

This table is optional and may be omitted if the platform prefers to store guest state in client-side storage, but as per current guidelines all user context must be in the DB. Each guest has a unique identifier for session state continuity and analytics.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest session was initiated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last activity by this guest during the session.

plainFields.name: last_seen_ip
plainFields.description: The IP address last recorded for this guest. Used for analytics and fraud detection.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer
models.description:
Represents an authenticated customer who can shop, manage wishlist, cart, and personal profile.

This table stores the core identity information of customers who have successfully registered and verified their email. Customers must authenticate to access cart, wishlist, order history, and personal data. This table enforces email uniqueness and securely stores password_hash for authentication.

Customers can create multiple shipping addresses and initiate order flows, but they are distinct from sellers and admins. This table is the foundation for all customer-facing functionality.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's primary email address, used for login, communication, and verification. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password using bcrypt or equivalent. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: full_name
plainFields.description: Full legal name of the customer, as provided during registration.

plainFields.name: date_of_birth
plainFields.description: Date of birth to ensure user is at least 13 years old per policy.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Optional phone number in E.164 format for SMS notifications and verification.

plainFields.name: profile_photo_url
plainFields.description: URL pointing to the customer's profile photo stored in CDN. Must be a valid HTTPS URI.

plainFields.name: is_email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the customer's email has been verified via link after registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created and registered.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the customer profile.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description:
Stores active authentication sessions for customers.

This table is used to track user sessions after login. Each session maps to exactly one customer and holds contextual data about the login event. Sessions are managed internally to handle authentication lifecycle and are not modified by users directly. This is a subsidiary system-managed table.

No token values are stored here; only metadata about the connection. Sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity or 1 hour with no activity, and are purged automatically.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated customer this session belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: The IP address from which the user logged in.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL (full path) where the user initiated the login session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The referring website or application that linked the user to the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created (login time).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session will expire. Must be set to 30 days after creation.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller
models.description:
Represents an authenticated business entity that can list and manage products on the platform.

This table stores identity information of vetted sellers who have been approved by an admin. Sellers are distinct from customers and admins—their core function is to manage inventory and fulfill orders. This table includes password_hash for secure login and is linked to other seller-specific tables.

Sellers must have their accounts approved before accessing seller tools. They cannot initiate claims or vote on other sellers' content. Access to this table is permission-limited to seller operations only.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller's primary email address, used for login, communication, and verification. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password using bcrypt or equivalent. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: business_name
plainFields.description: Legal or trading name of the seller's business, as registered with platform.

plainFields.name: is_approved
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the seller application has been reviewed and approved by an admin. Default false until approved.

plainFields.name: approval_note
plainFields.description: Optional note from the approving admin regarding approval status or conditions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller submitted the registration request.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the seller profile or approval status.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful login by this seller.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description:
Stores active authentication sessions for sellers.

This table tracks login sessions for sellers who manage product listings and order fulfillment. Sessions are issued upon successful authentication and expire after 30 days of inactivity. The seller can have multiple concurrent sessions across devices.

This table is exclusively managed by the system and never modified manually. It supports security monitoring and forced logout features.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated seller this session belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: The IP address from which the seller logged in.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL (full path) where the seller initiated the login session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The referring website or application that linked the seller to the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session will expire. Must be set to 30 days after creation.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin
models.description:
Represents a system administrator with full privileges over the platform's configuration and moderation.

This table stores identity information for superusers who can manage users, approve sellers, override inventory, manage categories, and review content. Admins are manually invited and granted elevated permissions. This table requires password_hash for login and is not accessible to customers or sellers.

Each admin has a unique designated set of permissions encoded in the JWT. This table enforces stricter authentication and session controls to protect system integrity.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin's primary email address, used for login and system communications. Must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password using bcrypt or equivalent. Never store plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: full_name
plainFields.description: Full legal name of the administrator.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the admin profile.

plainFields.name: last_login_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful login by this admin.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the admin account is currently active and permitted to log in. Default true.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description:
Stores active authentication sessions for administrators.

This table tracks login sessions for system admins who have elevated privileges. Admin sessions have a shorter expiration (1 hour) as per security policy and require re-authentication after short periods of inactivity.

Sessions are never allowed to persist beyond 1 hour unless manually extended via admin flag. Multiple admin sessions across devices are permitted. This table supports audit trails and forced logout features for security.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the authenticated admin this session belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_admin.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: The IP address from which the admin logged in.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: The URL (full path) where the admin initiated the login session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: The referring website or application that linked the admin to the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session will expire. Must be set to 1 hour after creation (or when transient override logs in).

models.name: shopping_mall_password_reset_tokens
models.description:
Stores tokens for password reset requests, valid for 15 minutes.

This table holds temporary tokens generated when users request to reset their password. Each token is single-use and expires after 15 minutes. When a token is used to reset a password, the system invalidates it immediately.

All tokens are stored securely with no plaintext values. This table helps prevent brute-force attacks by limiting token lifetime.

Takes precedence over email verification in case both exist simultaneously.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who requested the password reset. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who requested the password reset. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin who requested the password reset. {@link shopping_mall_admin.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Randomly generated, cryptographically secure token for password reset. Must be 64-character hash.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this token expires and becomes invalid. Must be set to 15 minutes after creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this token was generated.

plainFields.name: used
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this token has been used to reset the password. Default false.

models.name: shopping_mall_email_verification_tokens
models.description:
Stores tokens for email verification after registration, valid for 24 hours.

This table holds verification tokens sent to users after they register. Each token is single-use and expires after 24 hours. Once a token is used to verify an email, it is marked as used and cannot be reused.

Checks against customer, seller, and admin tables to confirm the user exists before validating. Used to prevent hijacked registrations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer whose email needs verification. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller whose email needs verification. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin whose email needs verification. {@link shopping_mall_admin.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Randomly generated, cryptographically secure token for email verification. Must be 64-character hash.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this token expires and becomes invalid. Must be set to 24 hours after creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this token was generated.

plainFields.name: used
plainFields.description: Indicates whether this token has been used to verify the email. Default false.

models.name: shopping_mall_two_factor_secrets
models.description:
Stores TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) secrets for 2FA enrollment.

This table holds the base32-encoded secret keys used to generate 2FA codes for users who enable two-factor authentication. Secrets are encrypted at rest and tied to individual actor accounts.

2FA secrets are only set after user approval of an 2FA setup, and users must validate the code before enrollment is final. This table supports backup recovery codes as well.

This table replaces the need for SMS 2FA because TOTP is more secure.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer who enabled 2FA. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller who enabled 2FA. {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin who enabled 2FA. {@link shopping_mall_admin.id}

plainFields.name: secret
plainFields.description: Base32-encoded secret key used to generate TOTP codes. Must be 32 characters.

plainFields.name: is_enabled
plainFields.description: Indicates whether 2FA is currently active for this account. Default false until confirmed.

plainFields.name: backup_codes
plainFields.description: JSON array of 10 one-time recovery codes (base64 encoded strings). Only populated after 2FA is confirmed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the 2FA secret was generated.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description:
Core product entity that defines the base product information including title, description and status. Each product represents a conceptual item for sale and may have one or more physically distinct variants (SKUs) with different pricing and inventory levels.

Products are owned by a specific seller and their visibility in the catalog is controlled by the status field. Store basic information that applies to all variants of a product while variants hold the specific sellable configurations.

Product history is preserved through timestamps and soft deletion capability. Products with historical orders cannot be deleted, but can be unpublished through status change.

Reference: {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} for sellable variants. {@link shopping_mall_seller} for seller ownership. {@link shopping_mall_product_attributes} for optional product attributes. {@link shopping_mall_product_tags} for categorization and discovery.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owner seller's {@link shopping_mall_seller.id}.

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Primary category of this product, related to {@link shopping_mall_product_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product name/title as displayed to customers. Must be unique per seller.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed product description. Supports rich text formatting for sellers to convey features and benefits.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Starting price for the product. Varied by each variant (SKU). Corresponds to the minimum available price among all variants.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product visibility status. Must be either 'active' or 'inactive'. Only 'active' products are visible to customers for purchase. Default: 'active'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this product was created. Automatically set upon creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this product was last modified. Updated on any edit.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. If null, product is active. If set, product is considered deleted and not visible to customers, though remains for historical reference.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_variants
models.description:
Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) entity that represents a distinct, sellable configuration of a product with unique inventory and pricing. Each variant corresponds to a specific combination of attributes such as color, size, material or other customizable options.

Variants enable atomic inventory management per physical product configuration. While a product (shopping_mall_products) represents the conceptual item, a variant represents what actually gets purchased, shipped, and tracked in stock.

Every product must have at least one variant. Variants inherit their core identity from the parent product but have independent pricing, inventory, and image properties.

Referenced only through their parent product. Cannot exist independently without a product.

Reference: {@link shopping_mall_products} for parent product. {@link shopping_mall_product_attribute_values} for attribute configurations.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product this variant belongs to, referencing {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique SKU code generated for this variant following pattern: {PRODUCT_CODE}-{COLOR_CODE}-{SIZE_CODE}-{MATERIAL_CODE}-{OPTION_CODE}. Ensures uniqueness across all variants in system.

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Specific price for this variant. Can differ from base product price. Each variant must have an explicitly defined price.

plainFields.name: inventory_count
plainFields.description: Current stock quantity available for this variant. Must be non-negative. Product sale reduces this value. Only variants with inventory_count > 0 are available for purchase.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL to the primary image for this variant. Optional. If not provided, uses the parent product's primary image.

plainFields.name: is_available
plainFields.description: Whether this variant is available for purchase. Controls visibility in UI. True if inventory_count > 0 and product status is 'active'. Managed automatically based on inventory and product status.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was created. Automatically set upon creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this variant was last modified. Updated on inventory or price changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. If null, variant is active. If set, variant is considered deleted and not available for purchase, though remains for historical reference.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description:
Images associated with products for visual representation. Each product can have multiple images (up to 5 as per requirements) to showcase different angles, details, or usage scenarios.

Images are managed as supporting entities tied to a specific product. They do not represent independent business entities and are always accessed through their parent product.

Used for display on product detail pages and search listings. When a variant has its own image specified, it will override the product's default image.

Reference: {@link shopping_mall_products} for parent product.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Product this image belongs to, referencing {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL to the image file hosted by system. Must be HTTPS and point to a valid image format (JPG, PNG, GIF).

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Alternative text description of the image for accessibility and SEO. Required for screen readers and text-based browsers.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Display order of the image among other images for this product. Lower values appear first. Ranges from 1-5 as per requirements. Default is 1 for first image, 2 for second, etc.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this image was uploaded. Automatically set upon upload.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_attributes
models.description:
Attribute definitions for products, representing the types of customizable properties that variants can have. These are categorical definitions like 'Color', 'Size', or 'Material' that can be selected when creating product variants.

Attribute definitions are created by admins or advanced sellers to standardize variant options across the platform. They are meta-data entities that enable consistent and maintainable variant creation.

Each attribute definition can have multiple possible values (shopping_mall_product_attribute_values), but an attribute definition itself is static and reusable across multiple products.

Never contains product-specific data. Purely a taxonomy definition structure.

Reference: {@link shopping_mall_product_attribute_values} for possible values of each attribute.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name of the attribute type, e.g., 'Color', 'Size', 'Material'. Must be unique across all attribute definitions.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description explaining what the attribute represents and how it is used in product variants.

plainFields.name: is_required
plainFields.description: Whether this attribute must be specified when creating a variant of a product. True if customer must make a selection. False if optional.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute definition was created. Automatically set upon creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute definition was last modified. Updated on any edit.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. If null, attribute is active. If set, attribute is considered deleted and cannot be used for new variants, though existing variants remain valid.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_attribute_values
models.description:
Specific values for product attribute definitions. Represents the individual options available for an attribute type (e.g., "Red", "Blue", "S", "M" for a color or size attribute).

Each value is tied to a specific attribute definition and represents a selectable option in variant creation. A variant selects multiple attribute values across different attribute definitions to form a complete configuration.

Enables a many-to-many relationship between attributes and variants through the attribute_value_id in shopping_mall_product_variants. Allows one attribute value to be reused across multiple products and variants.

Reference: {@link shopping_mall_product_attributes} for the attribute definition. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants} via junction for variant usage.

foreignFields.name: attribute_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the attribute definition, {@link shopping_mall_product_attributes.id}.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: The actual display value of the attribute, such as 'Red', 'Large', 'Cotton'. Must be human-readable for customer display.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Display order of this value among other values for the same attribute. Lower values appear first in UI.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute value was created. Automatically set upon creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute value was last modified. Updated on any edit.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. If null, attribute value is active. If set, attribute value is considered deleted and cannot be selected for new variants, though existing variants remain valid.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor that created or last modified this attribute value. Must be either 'seller' or 'admin'. Required for audit trail to distinguish origin of changes made by seller versus admin users.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_categories
models.description:
Category system for organizing products into hierarchical groupings. Used to structure the product catalog and enable browsing by product families.

Each product belongs to exactly one primary category, which defines its main classification in the system. Category structure is hierarchical and managed by admin for consistency.

This table represents the actual category taxonomy used for product categorization. Different from reference tables for general categories.

Reference: {@link shopping_mall_products} for products categorized under this category.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the category, e.g., 'Electronics', 'Clothing', 'Books'. Must be unique within the category hierarchy.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of what products belong in this category and what qualifies a product for inclusion.

plainFields.name: parent_id
plainFields.description: Parent category ID for hierarchical nesting. NULL indicates top-level category. Self-referential to form category tree structure.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Display order for categories at the same hierarchy level. Lower values appear first in navigation menus.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was created. Automatically set upon creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this category was last modified. Updated on any edit.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. If null, category is active. If set, category is considered deleted and no new products can be assigned to it, though existing products remain categorized.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_tags
models.description:
Junction table representing the many-to-many relationship between products and tags. Tags are keywords or phrases used for enhanced product discovery, filtering, and search.

Each product can have multiple tags and each tag can be associated with multiple products, making this a M:N relationship implemented through a junction table.

Tags provide a flexible way to categorize products beyond the rigid category hierarchy, enabling cross-cutting classification like 'bestseller', 'eco-friendly', 'on-sale', etc.

Reference: {@link shopping_mall_products} for products. {@link shopping_mall_product_tags_definitions} for tag definitions (but those aren't specified in target tables so we're using direct tagging).

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: Product this tag is associated with, referencing {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: tag_name
plainFields.description: The actual tag keyword or phrase used for discovery and filtering. Must be lowercase and alphanumeric with hyphens. Examples: "bestseller", "eco-friendly", "limited-edition".

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this tag association was created. Automatically set upon assignment.

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description:
Cart entity for authenticated customers that represents a collection of items being considered for purchase.

This table stores all cart metadata for registered customers, including total item count, total value, status, and timestamps.

Each record is associated with exactly one customer through the customer_id foreign key.

The cart can exist in one of three states: 'active', 'abandoned', or 'converted'. It persists for up to 30 days after last access.

This is a primary entity because authenticated customers directly interact with their cart (add, remove, update items) and require independent API operations.

Due to direct specification requirement, this table is maintained independently from guest carts even though structure is duplicated.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: The authenticated customer who owns this cart. References {@link shopping_mall_customer.id} (in otherTables).

plainFields.name: total_items
plainFields.description: Total number of items currently in this cart. Updated when items are added or removed.

plainFields.name: total_value
plainFields.description: Total monetary value of all items in this cart. Calculated as sum of (item quantity * unit price at addition). Excludes discounts and taxes.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description:
Current state of the cart. Valid values: 'active', 'abandoned', 'converted'.

- 'active': User has interacted recently and items are still valid.
- 'abandoned': User has not interacted for a defined period (7-30 days). Items remain valid but may be deleted by cleanup job.
- 'converted': Cart has been successfully converted to an order. Items are sealed and no longer modifiable.

plainFields.name: last_accessed
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last user interaction with this cart. Used for automatic cleanup jobs to identify expired carts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart was initially created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart was logically deleted. Null if cart is active. Used for soft delete to preserve audit trails and allow for cart recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description:
Individual product items added to a cart by a user.

Each cart item represents one instance of a product variant (SKU) being considered for purchase. It contains a snapshot of the product's price and inventory state at the moment of addition to the cart, ensuring transactional consistency regardless of future price or stock changes.

Cart items are primary entities because users can independently modify them (add, remove, change quantity) even within the cart context, and these operations require independent API endpoints for accurate state management.

A cart item has a parent association to either shopping_mall_carts or shopping_mall_guest_carts via cart_id, indicating which cart it belongs to. It must reference a valid product variant from shopping_mall_product_variants.

The status field indicates whether the item is still available or if its inventory has been depleted. Users can see this status and manually remove items marked as stale.

foreignFields.name: cart_id
foreignFields.description: The cart this item belongs to. References {@link shopping_mall_carts.id} (for authenticated users) or {@link shopping_mall_guest_carts.id} (for guests).

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The specific product variant (SKU) being added. References {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this product variant in the cart. Minimum value is 1, maximum is 100.

plainFields.name: unit_price_at_addition
plainFields.description: The exact price of the product variant at the moment it was added to the cart. Persisted to ensure consistent pricing during checkout, independent of future price changes.

plainFields.name: inventory_at_addition
plainFields.description: The available inventory count of this product variant at the moment it was added to the cart. Used to validate availability during checkout.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description:
Current availability status of this cart item. Valid values: 'available', 'out_of_stock', 'removed_by_user'.

- 'available': Item is in stock and the cart item is valid.
- 'out_of_stock': The product variant's inventory has dropped to 0 since this item was added.
- 'removed_by_user': User manually removed this item from cart.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was added to the cart.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was last updated (e.g., quantity changed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart item was logically deleted. Null if the item still exist in cart. Used for soft delete to preserve audit trails.

models.name: shopping_mall_guest_carts
models.description:
Cart entity for guest users that represents a collection of items being considered for purchase.

This table stores all cart metadata for unauthenticated guests, including total item count, total value, status, and timestamps.

Each record is associated with exactly one guest session through the guest_session_id foreign key.

The cart can exist in one of three states: 'active', 'abandoned', or 'converted'. It persists for up to 7 days after last access.

This is a primary entity because guest users directly interact with their cart (add, remove, update items) and require independent API operations for guest session management.

Due to direct specification requirement, this table is maintained independently from customer carts even though structure is duplicated.

foreignFields.name: guest_session_id
foreignFields.description: The session identifier for the guest user. References {@link shopping_mall_guest.id} (in otherTables). This defines which browser session this cart belongs to.

plainFields.name: total_items
plainFields.description: Total number of items currently in this cart. Updated when items are added or removed.

plainFields.name: total_value
plainFields.description: Total monetary value of all items in this cart. Calculated as sum of (item quantity * unit price at addition). Excludes discounts and taxes.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description:
Current state of the cart. Valid values: 'active', 'abandoned', 'converted'.

- 'active': User has interacted recently and items are still valid.
- 'abandoned': User has not interacted for a defined period (7-30 days). Items remain valid but may be deleted by cleanup job.
- 'converted': Cart has been successfully converted to an order. Items are sealed and no longer modifiable.

plainFields.name: last_accessed
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last user interaction with this cart. Used for automatic cleanup jobs to identify expired carts.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart was initially created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this cart was logically deleted. Null if cart is active. Used for soft delete to preserve audit trails and allow for cart recovery.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_promotions
models.description:
Promotional discount codes applied to cart items.

This table represents specific promotional discounts applied to individual cart items. Each record links a promotion code (e.g., 'SAVE10') to a specific cart_item, enabling item-level discounts.

This design supports promotions such as 'Buy one, get one 50% off' or 'Apply coupon to specific items' rather than cart-wide discounts, which allows for precise calculation and audit.

The promotion code value is stored as a string and referenced from an external promo registry (not modeled here, per complexity). This table only captures the application instance.

This table is subsidiary because its existence is entirely dependent on the cart item. It has no standalone meaning and is managed entirely through the cart item context.

foreignFields.name: cart_item_id
foreignFields.description: The cart item to which this promotion is applied. References {@link shopping_mall_cart_items.id}.

plainFields.name: promo_code
plainFields.description: The ID or code name of the promotion being applied (e.g., 'SAVE10'). Must be a valid promotion code as defined by admin. This links to an external promotion system.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: The exact discount amount (in USD) applied to this cart item. This represents the value reduced from the item's unit price_at_addition.

plainFields.name: discount_type
plainFields.description:
Type of discount applied. Valid values: 'percentage', 'fixed_amount'.

- 'percentage': discount_amount represents a percentage of the item's unit price.
- 'fixed_amount': discount_amount is a fixed USD value deducted from the item.

plainFields.name: applied_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion code was applied to this cart item.

plainFields.name: valid_until
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for this specific promotion application. Used to validate if discount is still valid during checkout.

models.name: shopping_mall_promotions
models.description:
Central registry of promotional codes used across the shoppingMall platform.

This table stores the definition of promotion codes and their parameters, such as discount type, amount, validity period, and usage limits.

This is a subsidiary entity because promotion codes are defined by administrators and applied to cart items through the promotion_applications table, but are not independently managed by users.

This table will replace the original shopping_mall_cart_promotions table which incorrectly used a 1:1 relationship with cart items. Separating the promotion definition from its application allows for the same promotion to be reused across multiple cart items (e.g., buy one get one discount) while maintaining data integrity.

Discouraging use of the original approach where promotion code was duplicated on every cart item application - this would lead to data inconsistency when promotion details changed.

When a promotion is modified, the definition in this table is updated, and existing applications remain correct (they reference a snapshot of the discount rules at time of application). This supports accurate audit trails for financial reconciliation.

plainFields.name: promo_code
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for the promotion (e.g., 'SAVE10', 'FREESHIP'). Must be globally unique across all active promotions.

plainFields.name: discount_amount
plainFields.description: The discount amount or percentage based on discount_type. For fixed_amount, this represents USD value to deduct. For percentage, this represents percentage of unit price to discount. All values expressed in USD.

plainFields.name: discount_type
plainFields.description:
Type of discount applied. Valid values: 'percentage', 'fixed_amount'.

- 'percentage': discount_amount represents a percentage of the cart item's unit_price_at_addition to deduct.
- 'fixed_amount': discount_amount is a fixed USD amount to deduct from the cart item's unit_price_at_addition.

plainFields.name: valid_from
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion becomes active. Promotions before this time are not applicable.

plainFields.name: valid_until
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion expires. Promotions after this time are not applicable.

plainFields.name: usage_limit
plainFields.description: Maximum number of times this promotion can be applied across all cart items. Null indicates unlimited usage.

plainFields.name: used_count
plainFields.description: Current number of times this promotion has been applied to cart items. Incremented when a cart_promotion_application is created.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this promotion is currently available for application. Set to false to archive promotion without deletion.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion was last modified.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion was logically deleted. Null if promotion is active. Used for soft delete to preserve audit trails for financial reporting.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_promotion_applications
models.description:
Instances of promotional codes applied to specific cart items.

This table represents the application of a promotion to a specific cart item. Each record establishes the relationship between a promotion and a cart item, storing the actual discount amount applied at time of application.

This is a subsidiary entity because it has no standalone meaning and exists only to connect cart items with promotions. It cannot be created, updated, or deleted independently of its parent cart item.

This table replaces the incorrect 1:1 relationship between cart_items and shopping_mall_cart_promotions, allowing multiple cart items to be associated with the same promotion (e.g., buy one get one discount), while still recording the exact discount applied to each item.

By separating the promotion definition (shopping_mall_promotions) from its application (this table), we maintain normalization and ensure financial accuracy even when promotions are modified after being applied.

foreignFields.name: cart_item_id
foreignFields.description: The cart item to which this promotion is applied. References {@link shopping_mall_cart_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: promotion_id
foreignFields.description: The promotion definition being applied. References {@link shopping_mall_promotions.id}.

plainFields.name: final_discount_amount
plainFields.description: The exact discount amount (in USD) actually applied to this cart item. Calculated as: promotion.discount_amount * (if percentage: unit_price_at_addition / 100) or promotion.discount_amount (if fixed_amount). This record is the immutable snapshot of discount applied at time of application, even if the promotion definition changes later.

plainFields.name: applied_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion code was applied to this cart item.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description:
Current application status. Valid values: 'active', 'expired', 'invalid'.

- 'active': The promotion is still valid and discount applies.
- 'expired': The promotion's valid_until has passed.
- 'invalid': The promotion's usage_limit has been reached or is inactive.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion application was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion application was last updated (e.g., status changed).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this promotion application was logically deleted. Null if still active. Used for soft delete to preserve audit trails.

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description:
Core order entity representing a confirmed purchase transaction.

Captures the immutable state of an order at the time of payment confirmation. This table serves as the root record for all order-related events and is referenced by every other order table.

Each order has a unique status sequence tracked in shopping_mall_order_statuses, payment details in shopping_mall_order_payments, shipping information in shopping_mall_order_shippings, and may be subject to cancellation or refund events.

Orders are owned by customers and linked via customer_id to shopping_mall_customer. Order total includes product prices locked at time of purchase, shipping fees, and calculated taxes.

This table enforces business rules: order cancellations are allowed only within 2 hours and refund requests require admin approval.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed the order. {@link shopping_mall_customer.id}.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique order identifier in format 'ORD-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXXXX' where XXXXXXXX is 8 hex characters. Guaranteed globally unique.

plainFields.name: subtotal
plainFields.description: Sum of product prices (from order_items) at time of purchase, before tax and shipping. Locked at order creation.

plainFields.name: shipping_cost
plainFields.description: Shipping fee calculated based on shipping address and method at time of checkout.

plainFields.name: tax_amount
plainFields.description: Sales tax calculated based on shipping address jurisdiction at time of checkout.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Final order amount: subtotal + shipping_cost + tax_amount. Locked at time of payment confirmation.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code (e.g., 'USD') in which the order was processed, matching shopping_mall_currencies.code.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the order: 'Processing', 'Shipped', 'Out for Delivery', 'Delivered', 'Cancelled'. Selected from ordered statuses in shopping_mall_order_statuses.

plainFields.name: payment_status
plainFields.description: Payment status: 'Pending Payment', 'Payment Processing', 'Paid', 'Payment Declined', 'Payment Failed', 'Refunded', 'Chargeback Initiated'. Reflects integration with payment gateway.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was created in system. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to order state (e.g., status change).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; if null, order is still active. Used for legal compliance and order history persistence.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description:
Individual line items within an order, representing specific product variants (SKUs) purchased.

Each order item corresponds to one product variant with a specific quantity, price, and attribute selection at the time of purchase. Prices are locked at order creation and do not change with product updates.

This table supports vendor aggregation: one order may contain items from multiple sellers via product variant ownership.

Items are never removed, even if product is deleted — they remain historical records for refunds and disputes. No duplicate items per order ID + variant ID combination is allowed.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order to which this item belongs. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: product_variant_id
foreignFields.description: The product variant (SKU) purchased. {@link shopping_mall_product_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this product variant in this order. Must be >= 1.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Price per unit of this variant at time of order. Locked to prevent change after purchase.

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Quantity multiplied by unit_price. Calculated at time of order creation but stored for integrity.

plainFields.name: variant_attributes
plainFields.description: JSON string describing the selected attributes for this variant (e.g., {"color": "Red", "size": "Large"}). Created from shopping_mall_product_attributes and shopping_mall_product_attribute_values.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_payments
models.description:
Records payment attempts and settlement details for each order.

Each order has exactly one payment record that stores payment method, transaction ID, amount, and status returned by the payment gateway.

Payment data is never stored raw — only tokenized references and gateways' response data are stored. This table is the single source of truth for payment success/failure and refund eligibility.

Payment_Status in shopping_mall_orders is derived from this table's status but stored for quick querying.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: The order this payment belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: payment_gateway_id
foreignFields.description: The payment provider used (e.g., Stripe, PayPal). {@link shopping_mall_payment_gateways.id}.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Amount paid in order's currency. Should equal shopping_mall_orders.total_amount.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code of the payment. Must match order's currency.

plainFields.name: payment_method
plainFields.description: Type of payment: 'credit_card', 'apple_pay', 'google_pay', 'paypal', 'affirm', 'klarna'.

plainFields.name: payment_gateway_ref_id
plainFields.description: Unique transaction ID provided by the payment gateway (e.g., 'ch_123456789').

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Status from payment gateway: 'pending', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'declined', 'refund_initiated', 'chargeback_initiated'.

plainFields.name: failure_reason
plainFields.description: Human-readable reason for failure if status = 'failed' or 'declined' (e.g., 'insufficient_funds', 'expired_card').

plainFields.name: transaction_date
plainFields.description: Timestamp when payment was processed by the gateway.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment record was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when payment state was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_shippings
models.description:
Stores shipping configuration and destination details for each order.

Contains the shipping address, method chosen, and carrier-specific settings at time of order confirmation.

This table determines tax calculation accuracy and estimated delivery time.

The address is saved as a snapshot and cannot be modified after order payment is captured (per business rule).

Links to shopping_mall_zones for shipping rate calculation and shopping_mall_countries for address validation.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: The order this shipping belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: zone_id
foreignFields.description: Geographic shipping zone used to calculate rates. {@link shopping_mall_zones.id}.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Full name of the recipient (first + last).

plainFields.name: address_line1
plainFields.description: Primary street address (e.g., '123 Main Street').

plainFields.name: address_line2
plainFields.description: Secondary address (e.g., apartment, unit, floor). Optional.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City or town name.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State, province, or region name.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code.

plainFields.name: country_code
plainFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., 'US', 'JP').

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Phone number of recipient in E.164 international format (e.g., '+1234567890').

plainFields.name: shipping_method
plainFields.description: Selected delivery option (e.g., 'Standard', 'Expedited', 'Same-Day').

plainFields.name: carrier
plainFields.description: Logistics carrier providing service (e.g., 'FedEx', 'UPS', 'DHL', 'LocalCourier').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when shipping details were configured at checkout.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp if shipping details are modified by admin before shipment.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_statuses
models.description:
Historical audit trail of status changes for orders.

Each status transition results in a new row, immutable upon creation. This table preserves the complete history of order lifecycle stages: Processing → Shipped → Out for Delivery → Delivered → Cancelled.

No updates are permitted on existing records — only insertions of new status entries. Sequential order is preserved by created_at.

Status transitions are auto-triggered by system events (e.g., payment success, carrier scan). Admins may manually override status for exception handling.

This table implements a snapshot architecture principle: re-construcing an order's state at any point in time requires sequencing from this table.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: The order this status change belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: The status value applied (e.g., 'Processing', 'Shipped'). Must be one of: 'Processing', 'Shipped', 'Out for Delivery', 'Delivered', 'Cancelled'.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional reason or context for the status change (e.g., 'System initiated after payment confirmation', 'Admin overrode due to customer request').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status change was recorded. Used to sequence history.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Always equals created_at; no updates permitted on snapshot records.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_tracking_numbers
models.description:
Tracks carrier-provided tracking numbers associated with shipped orders.

Each shipping can have only one tracking number per carrier instance.

Tracking numbers are validated against carrier format (e.g., 12-digit numeric for FedEx, alphanumeric for DHL) upon entry.

The tracking number triggers automatic status updates via external carrier APIs (when 'Shipped' → 'Out for Delivery' → 'Delivered').

This table stores tracking URLs to link to external carrier tracking pages.

foreignFields.name: order_shipping_id
foreignFields.description: The shipping record this tracking number belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_order_shippings.id}.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Carrier-provided tracking identifier (e.g., '9400110898608891367704'). Must validate against carrier format.

plainFields.name: tracking_url
plainFields.description: Direct URL to track this package on the carrier's website (e.g., 'https://www.fedex.com/tracking?track=9400110898608891367704').

plainFields.name: carrier
plainFields.description: Carrier name matching the shipping record (e.g., 'FedEx', 'UPS', 'DHL'). Must be consistent with shopping_mall_order_shippings.carrier.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when tracking number was added to the system.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_cancellations

models.name: orders
models.description:

Each order has a unique status sequence tracked in order_statuses, payment details in order_payments, shipping information in order_shippings, and may be subject to cancellation or refund events.

models.name: order_statuses

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Always equals created_at; no updates permitted on snapshot records.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description:
Product reviews submitted by verified customers.

Stores written feedback from customers who have purchased a specific product variant (SKU). Each review is linked to a specific customer and product variant, ensuring the verified purchase badge can be accurately displayed. Reviews start in PENDING status and must be approved by an admin before being visible to the public.

This entity supports the core review functionality, including moderation, abuse reporting, and historical tracking. Only authenticated customers who have made a purchase can submit reviews, and each review is permanently associated with the specific SKU variant purchased.

Soft deletion is supported for moderation purposes. When a review is flagged or rejected, deleted_at is set. The system preserves all review data in the database for legal and audit compliance regardless of visibility.

Referenced by: shopping_mall_review_replies, shopping_mall_review_reports, shopping_mall_review_moderation_log.

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Star rating from 1 to 5, where 1 is Very Poor and 5 is Excellent. Required field for all submissions.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the review (up to 100 characters). Usually a summary of the customer's experience.

plainFields.name: content
plainFields.description: Detailed review content written by the customer. Minimum 50 characters required. Can contain comments about usability, quality, and overall satisfaction.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Moderation status of the review. Values: PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, FLAGGED. Initially PENDING until an admin reviews it.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this review was originally submitted.

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shopping_mall_review_replies

Seller responses can only be created once per review and cannot be edited after submission to maintain integrity.

This entity exists only to support the customer's review by allowing seller engagement. The content of replies is moderated by admins and automatically flagged for abuse, profanity, or links.

Replies are not independently managed by users and are always associated with a single, existing approved review. The system ensures sellers cannot respond to their own reviews or to flagged/rejected reviews.

Referenced by: shopping_mall_review_moderation_log.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

Abuse reports submitted by users against reviews.

Records user-initiated reports of inappropriate or abusive review content. Each report is associated with a specific review, a reporting user (customer), and includes a reason for the report. Reports help trigger automatic and manual moderation workflows.

When a review receives three or more abuse reports within 24 hours, the system automatically flags the review for admin review. Reports are confidential - the reporting user's identity is not disclosed to the review author or seller.

This is a subsidiary system-maintained entity that facilitates moderation but is not directly managed by users individually.

Each entry contains the admin ID, target entity (review or reply), action type, timestamp, and optional notes. This ensures complete transparency of moderation decisions.

plainFields.name: website_url

plainFields.name: return_policy
plainFields.description: Seller's return policy details, up to 5,000 characters.

plainFields.name: shipping_policy
plainFields.description: Seller's shipping policy details, up to 5,000 characters.
